name: Lancastrian Billmen
headerMeta: Heroic era · Pike/Polearm infantry · anti-cav · 220 leadership · T4
pitch: A bleed-and-brace pike unit that rewards active play in infantry engagements and survives cavalry if well-positioned. Two veterancy lines offer a genuine playstyle fork: the lower path maximizes bleed damage and micro intensity, while the upper path prioritizes anti-cavalry stability and demands positioning discipline.

veterancy.label: Lower line (damage/bleed-focused)
veterancy.body: Active, micro-heavy path that favors bleed stacking over time in tight spaces and infantry-heavy engagements; short, well-timed engagements create sustained pressure via bleed compound in prolonged fights. {2}

veterancy.label: Upper line (anti-cavalry/defensive)
veterancy.body: Passive-stable, lower-micro option that trades damage for survivability; recommended when facing cavalry-heavy compositions; proper positioning lets the tankier build passively disrupt/slow enemy pushes. {2}

battleRole.positioning: Pike-focused positioning — maintain brace against cavalry arrivals, keeping model spacing and formation discipline to prevent flanks {1}. Never move formation while fighting or you will lose all damage {1}. Good positioning matters more on the upper (tank) line; poor positioning still loses the unit quickly regardless of the tankier stat line {2}.
battleRole.tips: Play like any pikes; coordinate brace with your stalwart or current meta shield {1}. Short, well-timed engagements tend to feel more effective on the bleed path; when used carefully, the pressure created by bleed can slowly swing a fight {2}.
